findings.summary: oldestDays is clamped to a minimum of 1 instead of 0, contradicting the stated fix.
findings.mechanism: Math.max(1, ...stuckRows.map(...)) was written where Math.max(0, ...) was intended. When every stuck row's floored age is 0 (all first-seen at or after this run's startedAt, i.e. same-run observation), the result is forced to 1 instead of 0, so the notification reports a 1-day-old stuck item that is actually 0 days old — the exact off-by-one the change claims to fix, just shifted rather than removed.
